metadata.description: Task-routing plugin: decide whether to delegate, what shape to use, and which model tier and reasoning effort to spend.

plugins.name: intelligent-delegate
plugins.description: Routes a task to the cheapest execution shape that still gets it right — inline, a single subagent, or a Workflow fan-out — and picks the model tier and reasoning effort to match. Ships five pre-tiered agent definitions so effort is actually reachable from the Agent tool.
